🔴AI industry mein is samay investors sabse zyada ek baat dekh rahe hain company kitna revenue kama rahi hai, kitna profit bana rahi hai, AI infrastructure par kitna paisa kharch kar rahi hai aur us investment ka return kab milega. OpenAI, Google, Microsoft aur doosri badi AI companies data centers, GPUs aur AI models par bahut bade paimane par investment kar rahi hain. Lekin agar customers ko Chinese AI companies ya open-source models wahi quality bahut kam price mein milne lage, to premium models bechna mushkil ho sakta hai. Isse investors ko dar lagta hai ki itna bada investment future mein utna profit generate karega ya nahi. Isi uncertainty ki wajah se AI-related companies ke shares par pressure aata hai aur market mein selling dekhne ko mil sakti hai.
🔴Agar Chinese AI companies kam cost mein achhe models provide karti hain, to global AI market mein price war shuru ho sakti hai. Price war ka matlab hai ki OpenAI, Google, Anthropic aur doosri companies ko bhi apni services ki pricing kam karni pad sakti hai. Jab selling price kam hoti hai aur infrastructure ka kharcha utna hi rehta hai, to profit margin ghat sakta hai. Isi liye investors sirf yeh nahi dekhte ki company ke paas achha AI model hai, balki yeh bhi dekhte hain ki woh AI ko sustainable aur profitable business mein kaise badlegi. Aaj market ka sabse bada sawaal AI capability nahi, balki AI monetization hai  yani itne bade investment se actual profit kab aur kitna aayega.
🔴Maan lo Balaji Wafers ko apna business badhane ke liye ₹500 ki zarurat hai. Investors company mein ₹500 invest kar dete hain, kyunki unhe bharosa hai ki Balaji ke wafers ki demand bahut zyada hai,  products aasani se bik jaate hain. Company wafers bechkar kuch samay baad ₹900 kama leti hai. Isme ₹500 investment recover ho jata hai aur ₹400 ka profit bachta hai. Isi profit aur future growth ki ummeed ki wajah se investors paisa lagate hain.
🔴AI companies ke case mein investors ka sawaal yeh hai ki agar company AI par ₹500 invest kare, lekin competition ki wajah se products saste mein bechne pad jaayein, to kya woh ₹900 kama payegi ya nahi. Agar is par doubt ho, to investors share bechna shuru kar dete hain.

@Hazza.6687 Bhai, thoda economics ka ABCD sikh le, fir aakar gyan dena! Tu Nominal aur Real GDP ka farak hi nahi samajh pa raha hai, tabhi aisi baatein kar raha hai:

Nominal GDP kya hoti hai? Yeh dollar/rupee ke current exchange rate aur inflation par calculate hoti hai. Jaise-jaise dollar ke muqable currency upar-neeche hoti hai aur cheezein mehngi hoti hain, yeh number badal jata hai.

Real GDP kya hoti hai? Asli growth isse dekhi jaati hai—ki desh ke andar mal (goods & services) ka production kitna bada hai! Isliye jab economy lagbhag 7% ki रफ्तार se badh rahi hai, toh country ka size grow ho raha hai, chahe exchange rate ki wajah se dollar terms ke aakde alag dikhein.

Sarkar koi jhoot nahi bol rahi, bas tu 'Current Price (Nominal)' aur 'Constant Price (Real)' ka basic farak nahi samajh pa raha hai. Thoda homework kar le, fir aana!
